roi_graph.coupled_weight: positive/negative tanh(z), each normalized by sum(abs weights); epsilon1e-12; zero channel=0

B0.name: 原始P0
B0.bank_note: No auxiliary ROI branch. Bank field is unused; the actual original P0 path uses its 8 frozen texts.

rng_policy: Each config independently preserves native continuous tenfold stream, seed once. Isolated new init fork_rng(150000+seed); no fold reseeding or baseline anchors. Same entry=>same trunk; later entries may diverge after different stopping lengths.
design_notes: Coupled decoder output bias would cancel in zero-reference subtraction, omitted equally for B5-B9; 39201 new parameters.
B3/B4 retain all 38242 parameters and 65 decoder inputs; only final FC input is zero.
Same-shape zero decoder reference; no detach; exact zero input produces exact zero output.
No successful-response requirement during formal training; an unused semantic branch remains a valid negative result.

preflight_repairs.issue: Broadcast one zero reference on PPU produced tiny rounding residual at all-zero node input
preflight_repairs.fix: Use original same-shape decoder(torch.zeros_like(edge_context)); parameters/math/configs unchanged

postflight_runner_fix.scope: Boundary recovery; report/metadata refinement distinguishes positive correct-mapping evidence from full medical-necessity criterion; no training operators changed
postflight_runner_fix.reconstruction: Reverse runner_change_diff to recover the original training runner SHA256 exactly; differences affect boundary recovery and prose generation only.
